}]]></client_script_v2><comments/><condition/><form_action>false</form_action><form_button>false</form_button><form_button_icon/><form_button_v2>false</form_button_v2><form_context_menu>false</form_context_menu><form_link>false</form_link><form_menu_button_v2>false</form_menu_button_v2><form_style/><format_for_configurable_workspace>false</format_for_configurable_workspace><hint/><isolate_script>false</isolate_script><list_action>false</list_action><list_banner_button>false</list_banner_button><list_button>false</list_button><list_button_icon/><list_choice>false</list_choice><list_context_menu>false</list_context_menu><list_link>false</list_link><list_save_with_form_button>false</list_save_with_form_button><list_style/><messages/><name>Preview Discovery Filter</name><onclick/><order>100</order><script><![CDATA[gs.include("IllumioConstants");
(function executePreviewDiscoveryFilter(current, action, gs) {
    var mappingSysId = current.getUniqueValue();
    var tableName = current.getTableName();
    var redirectUrl = tableName + '.do?sys_id=' + mappingSysId;

    if (gs.nil(mappingSysId)) {
        gs.addErrorMessage("Unable to determine Config Class Mapping.");
        action.setRedirectURL(redirectUrl);
        return;
    }

    try {
        var sourceTable = current.getValue('source_table');
        var condition = current.getValue('conditions_for_excluding_workloads');
        var filterMode = current.getValue('filter_mode') || 'exclusion_legacy';

        if (gs.nil(sourceTable)) {
            gs.addErrorMessage("No source table configured on this mapping.");
            action.setRedirectURL(redirectUrl);
            return;
        }

        var hostFieldGr = new GlideRecordSecure('x_illu2_illumio_illumio_class_field_mapping');
        hostFieldGr.addQuery('illumio_config_class_mapping', mappingSysId);
        hostFieldGr.addQuery('type', 'host_name');
        hostFieldGr.addActiveQuery();
        hostFieldGr.setLimit(1);
        hostFieldGr.query();

        if (!hostFieldGr.next()) {
            gs.addErrorMessage("Preview requires a hostname field mapping. Configure a Host Name mapping first.");
            action.setRedirectURL(redirectUrl);
            return;
        }

        var isAdvancedHostname = hostFieldGr.getValue('advanced') == '1';
        var hostnameField = isAdvancedHostname ? null : hostFieldGr['ci_field'].getDisplayValue();

        var previewGr = new GlideRecord(sourceTable);
        var maxRecords = parseInt(gs.getProperty("x_illu2_illumio.maximum_ci_records") || '25000');
        previewGr.setLimit(maxRecords);

        var useGlideFilter = false;
        if (!gs.nil(condition)) {
            if (filterMode === 'inclusion') {
                previewGr.addEncodedQuery(condition);
            } else if (filterMode === 'exclusion_optimized') {
                previewGr.addEncodedQuery('^NQ' + condition);
            } else {
                useGlideFilter = true;
            }
        }

        previewGr.query();

        var excludeFilter;
        if (useGlideFilter && !gs.nil(condition)) {
            excludeFilter = new GlideFilter(condition, "previewExcludeFilter");
            if (IS_CASE_SENSITIVE == "false") {
                excludeFilter.setCaseSensitive(false);
            }
        }

        var recordCount = 0;
        var excludedCount = 0;
        var headers = ['sys_id', 'name', 'sys_class_name', 'ip_address', 'hostname'];
        var lines = [headers.join(',')];
        var discoverHelper = new IllumioDiscoverAndMapCMDBServers();

        while (previewGr.next()) {
            if (excludeFilter) {
                if (excludeFilter.match(previewGr, true)) {
                    excludedCount++;
                    continue;
                }
            }

            recordCount++;
            var row = [];
            for (var h = 0; h < headers.length; h++) {
                var val = '';
                if (headers[h] === 'hostname' && hostnameField) {
                    val = discoverHelper.getValueFromDotWalkableField(previewGr, hostnameField) || '';
                } else if (headers[h] === 'hostname' && isAdvancedHostname) {
                    val = '(script-based)';
                } else {
                    val = previewGr.getValue(headers[h]) || '';
                }
                if (val.indexOf(',') !== -1 || val.indexOf('"') !== -1) {
                    val = '"' + val.replace(/"/g, '""') + '"';
                }
                row.push(val);
            }
            lines.push(row.join(','));
        }

        if (recordCount === 0) {
            var zeroMsg = "No CMDB records match the current filter configuration.";
            if (excludedCount > 0) {
                zeroMsg += " (" + excludedCount + " record(s) excluded by condition.)";
            }
            gs.addInfoMessage(zeroMsg);
            action.setRedirectURL(redirectUrl);
            return;
        }

        var csvContent = lines.join('\n');

        var now = new GlideDateTime();
        var displayValue = now.getDisplayValue().replace(/[:\s]/g, '-').replace(/[^0-9\-]/g, '').split('-');
        var yy = (displayValue[0] || '00').slice(-2);
        var mm = ('0' + (displayValue[1] || '0')).slice(-2);
        var dd = ('0' + (displayValue[2] || '0')).slice(-2);
        var hh = ('0' + (displayValue[3] || '0')).slice(-2);
        var min = ('0' + (displayValue[4] || '0')).slice(-2);
        var fileName = 'DISCOVERY-PREVIEW-' + dd + '-' + mm + '-' + yy + '-' + hh + '-' + min + '.csv';

        var targetGr = new GlideRecord(tableName);
        targetGr.get(mappingSysId);

        var sa = new GlideSysAttachment();
        var existingAttachments = sa.getAttachments(tableName, mappingSysId);
        while (existingAttachments.next()) {
            if ((existingAttachments.getValue('file_name') || '').indexOf('DISCOVERY-PREVIEW-') === 0) {
                sa.deleteAttachment(existingAttachments.getUniqueValue());
            }
        }

        var attachmentSysId = sa.write(targetGr, fileName, 'text/csv', csvContent);

        if (gs.nil(attachmentSysId)) {
            gs.error('[PreviewDiscoveryFilter] GlideSysAttachment.write returned nil. FileName: ' + fileName + ', CSV length: ' + csvContent.length);
            gs.addErrorMessage("Failed to generate discovery preview CSV. Check application logs for details.");
        } else {
            var modeLabel = filterMode === 'inclusion' ? 'Inclusion' :
                            filterMode === 'exclusion_optimized' ? 'Exclusion (Optimized)' : 'Exclusion (Legacy)';
            var msg = recordCount + " CMDB record(s) will be processed by discovery (mode: " + modeLabel + "). Preview CSV attached.";
            if (excludedCount > 0) {
                msg += " " + excludedCount + " record(s) excluded.";
            }
            gs.addInfoMessage(msg);
        }
    } catch (ex) {
        gs.error('[PreviewDiscoveryFilter] Exception: ' + ex);
        gs.addErrorMessage("Error generating discovery preview: " + ex);
    }

    action.setRedirectURL(redirectUrl);
})(current, action, gs);]]></script><show_form_icon_only>false</show_form_icon_only><show_insert>true</show_insert><show_list_icon_only>false</show_list_icon_only><show_multiple_update>false</show_multiple_update><show_query>false</show_query><show_update>true</show_update><sys_class_name>sys_ui_action</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-02 08:01:05</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>1ec09e0ec3c7031050bffa0ed40131e7</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Preview Discovery Filter</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Illumio" source="x_illu2_illumio">15314f1ddb882700dc9fabc5ca961943</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Illumio">15314f1ddb882700dc9fabc5ca961943</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ui_action_1ec09e0ec3c7031050bffa0ed40131e7</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-02 08:01:05</sys_updated_on><table/><ui11_compatible>true</ui11_compatible><ui16_compatible>false</ui16_compatible></sys_ui_action></record_update>
